crop_img_and_mask: crop a PIL image and its segmentation mask to a random square region of the given size
hflip_img_and_mask: randomly horizontally flip a PIL image and its segmentation mask with a configurable probability
normalize_img_and_mask: normalize a PIL image using ImageNet statistics and optionally convert a mask to a PyTorch tensor
resize_img_and_mask: resize a PIL image and segmentation mask by a random ratio while preserving aspect ratio
review_transform_functions: review the transform module functions for semantic segmentation data augmentation pipelines
